title: Speaking — Sports as a spectator
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on sports as a spectator.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
Do you watch matches in person or on a screen?
What makes a match interesting to you?

part2.topic: Describe a sporting event whose atmosphere you remember.
part2.closing: and explain why its atmosphere was memorable.

questions: What benefits do local sports teams bring to their communities?
How has television coverage changed the way people support teams?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to sports as a spectator?
